dmn_experiences.title: A Tasting Tour of London's Craft Breweries
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Bermondsey's beer mile, visiting four taprooms with tutored tastings led by an accredited Beer Sommelier and Certified Cicerone. Groups are limited to 14 people.
highlights: Visits four taprooms on Bermondsey's beer mile
Tutored tastings led by a Beer Sommelier and Certified Cicerone
Learn about beer styles, history and how to evaluate beer
Small groups of up to 14 people
